Abu Nahal held a number of senior positions in the apparatus, including deputy head and head of its Northern District. Approximately two months ago, he assumed the role of head of the Internal Security Apparatus after the IDF and ISA apprehended his predecessor. Abu Nahal was a senior figure with long tenure in the terrorist organization and possessed extensive institutional knowledge.

His elimination constitutes a blow to the apparatus's management capabilities and follows a series of significant eliminations within Hamas' security apparatuses, including senior officials in the General Security Service and the police.

Throughout the war, and specifically in recent times, the terrorist advanced attacks against IDF troops and civilians of Israel, and worked to restore the capabilities of terrorist organizations in the Gaza Strip, while systematically violating the ceasefire. The terrorist was eliminated in an aerial strike in order to remove the threat he posed.

Prior to the strike, measures were taken to mitigate harm to civilians, including the use of precision munitions and aerial surveillance. 

IDF troops are deployed in the area in accordance with the agreement and will continue to eliminate any immediate threat.
